sources_scanned: Think Tanks (Brookings, RAND, WEF, KPMG, McKinsey, Deloitte)
Technology News (TechCrunch, Wired, MIT Tech Review, ScienceDaily)
General Web Search (emerging trends, policy, societal, environmental, economic, security)

signals.title: Iran War Reshapes Global Economy — Oil at $120/barrel, Supply Chains Disrupted
signals.summary: Operation Epic Fury, the US-Israel joint military operation against Iran, has entered its fourth week. Iran rejected the 15-point peace plan. Brent crude surged to $120/barrel. Cascading economic effects reshaping commodity markets, food systems, and industrial supply chains globally.
signals.implications: Prolonged conflict risks structural shock to global economy. Energy-dependent industries and emerging markets face disproportionate impact. Potential catalyst for accelerated energy transition.

signals.title: White House Releases National AI Policy Framework — Sector-Specific, No New Regulator
signals.summary: The White House unveiled a 7-recommendation AI policy framework urging Congress to maintain sector-specific regulation, avoid creating a new federal AI regulator, establish regulatory sandboxes, and invest in AI workforce fluency. Published March 20, 2026.
signals.implications: Sets the tone for US AI governance diverging from EU's centralized approach. Regulatory sandboxes could accelerate innovation but may leave gaps in high-risk AI oversight.

signals.title: Supreme Court Rules President Cannot Use IEEPA for Tariffs — Trade Policy in Flux
signals.summary: The Supreme Court ruled the President cannot use IEEPA to impose tariffs. The administration pivoted to Section 301 investigations against China, Vietnam, Taiwan, Mexico, Japan, EU, and dozens of others. US tariff rates remain at highest since WWII, averaging $1,500 per household.
signals.implications: Creates legal uncertainty for existing tariffs. Section 301 pathway will be slower and more targeted. Businesses face prolonged planning uncertainty.

signals.title: SEC/CFTC Classify 16 Major Cryptocurrencies as Digital Commodities — Not Securities
signals.summary: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and 13 other cryptocurrencies officially classified as digital commodities under joint SEC/CFTC interpretive release. Staking reclassified as administrative activity. GENIUS Act creates comprehensive federal stablecoin framework.
signals.implications: Landmark regulatory clarity could unlock institutional capital inflows. US positioning itself as crypto-friendly jurisdiction, potentially shifting global digital asset market dynamics.

signals.title: New START Treaty Expired — No U.S.-Russia Nuclear Arms Limits for First Time in Decades
signals.summary: New START expired February 5, 2026, removing caps on US and Russian long-range nuclear forces. Russia said it would voluntarily observe limits. China's stockpile projected to reach 1,000 warheads by 2030. NPT review conference scheduled for April 27.
signals.implications: First time since 1972 with no bilateral nuclear arms limits. Risk of new arms race. China's rapid buildup adds multipolar dimension to nuclear competition.

signals.title: Global Semiconductor Revenue to Surpass $1 Trillion — But Iran War Threatens Supply Chains
signals.summary: Global semiconductor revenues projected to surpass $1 trillion in 2026 driven by AI demand. However, Iran conflict threatens Helium and Bromine supply chains critical for chip manufacturing. Memory segment emerging as single largest friction point. Hua Hong readying 7nm capacity in China.
signals.implications: AI demand continues to drive explosive growth, but geopolitical risks could create severe bottlenecks. Chinese advanced node capability closing gap with global leaders.

signals.title: Fujitsu-Osaka Quantum Computing Breakthrough for Chemical Material Energy Calculations
signals.summary: Fujitsu and University of Osaka developed technology enabling energy calculations for chemical material design (e.g., catalyst molecules) within realistic timeframes on early fault-tolerant quantum computers (FTQC). This advances industrial quantum computing applications.
signals.implications: Bridges gap between theoretical quantum advantage and practical industrial use. Catalyst design acceleration could impact energy, pharmaceuticals, and materials science.

signals.title: Morgan Stanley Warns AI Breakthrough Coming in H1 2026 — 'Most of the World Isn't Ready'
signals.summary: Morgan Stanley issued a warning that a major AI breakthrough is anticipated in the first half of 2026 and most of the world is unprepared. GPT-5.2, Gemini 3, and Claude Opus 4.6 demonstrate near-perfect benchmark scores. AI agent systems showing early signs of autonomous reasoning.
signals.implications: Potential inflection point for AI capabilities. Organizations without AI strategies risk rapid obsolescence. Regulatory frameworks lagging behind technical progress.

signals.title: Waymo Expands to 10 Metro Areas, Targets 1 Million Rides/Week by Year-End
signals.summary: Waymo launched autonomous ride-hailing in Dallas, Houston, San Antonio, and Orlando simultaneously, reaching 10 commercial metro areas. Targets over 1 million rides per week by end of 2026. Nvidia's Alpamayo platform powers new Lucid-Nuro-Uber robotaxi alliance.
signals.implications: Autonomous mobility shifting from pilot to mass deployment phase. Major implications for transportation workforce, urban planning, and insurance industries.

signals.title: EU AI Act High-Risk Rules Delayed — Council Agrees to 16-Month Timeline Extension
signals.summary: EU Council agreed to delay AI Act high-risk system rules by up to 16 months until standards and tools are ready. Meanwhile, US states (California, Texas, Colorado) entering compliance phase for their own AI laws.
signals.implications: Signals EU acknowledging implementation complexity. Diverging US-EU approaches create compliance challenges for global AI companies. Multi-layered governance emerging.

signals.title: World Enters 'Era of Global Water Bankruptcy' — UN Formal Declaration
signals.summary: UN scientists formally declared the dawn of an 'era of global water bankruptcy' marked by groundwater depletion, water overallocation, land degradation, deforestation, and pollution, all compounded by global heating. Affects billions worldwide.
signals.implications: Water scarcity emerging as primary constraint on agriculture, industry, and data center expansion. Will accelerate geopolitical tensions over shared water resources.

signals.title: World on Course to Breach 1.5C Before 2030 — Paris Agreement Target Slipping
signals.summary: If the warming rate of the past 10 years continues, the Paris Agreement 1.5C limit will be breached by approximately 2030. EU approved 90% emissions reduction target by 2040. Climate change accelerating while natural systems' adaptive capacity declining.
signals.implications: Adaptation strategies becoming as critical as mitigation. Insurance, agriculture, and infrastructure sectors face growing physical risk pricing challenges.

signals.title: Agentic AI Breaches Surge — 1 in 8 Companies Report AI-Linked Security Incidents
signals.summary: 1 in 8 companies report AI breaches linked to agentic systems. Microsoft documented threat actors using role-based jailbreaks to bypass AI safety controls. Shadow AI usage jumped to 76% of organizations. NIST soliciting feedback on AI agent security standards.
signals.implications: AI security emerging as critical enterprise risk. Speed of AI agent deployment outpacing security frameworks. New attack surfaces (model poisoning, jailbreaks) require novel defenses.

signals.title: Sodium-Ion Batteries Reach Lithium-Ion Cost Parity — Grid-Scale Deployment Begins
signals.summary: Sodium-ion batteries reaching cost parity with lithium-ion. CATL deploying at scale across four sectors. Peak Energy deploying grid-scale storage in US. New 'wet' material breakthrough doubles charge capacity. 100 MWh utility-scale projects being commissioned.
signals.implications: Could disrupt lithium supply chain dominance and reduce battery costs dramatically. Sodium abundance eliminates geographic supply concentration risk.

signals.title: KPMG: Geopolitical Shocks Creating 'Butterfly Effect' on Global Economic Outlook
signals.summary: KPMG's March 2026 Economic Compass warns of cascading geopolitical shocks: Iran war, Strait of Hormuz disruption, Middle East energy crisis, and policy uncertainty. Government spending constrained at all levels. Federal deficit to eclipse economy size for first time since WWII.
signals.implications: Multiple simultaneous economic stressors increasing recession risk. Fiscal space exhausted, limiting government countercyclical options.

signals.title: WTO: Global Merchandise Trade Growth to Slow Sharply to 1.9% in 2026
signals.summary: WTO projects global merchandise trade growth will slow to 1.9% in 2026, down from 4.6% in 2025. The decline is attributed to the normalization after AI-related trade boom and tariff frontloading. US-China trade deficit narrowed but migrated to Vietnam and Taiwan.
signals.implications: Trade deceleration signals broader economic cooling. Supply chain restructuring ('friend-shoring') creating new trade corridors but not reducing overall vulnerability.

signals.title: H5N1 Bird Flu Circulating in More Species and Continents Than Ever — Pandemic Watch
signals.summary: H5N1 bird flu circulating in more species across more continents than ever before and is entrenched in global wildlife. Scientists monitoring for human-to-human transmission mutations. Measles cases surged 20% in 2023 to 10.3 million, continuing into 2026. Vaccine-preventable disease resurgence accelerating.
signals.implications: Pandemic preparedness infrastructure under strain. WHO warns global preparedness is 'fragile and uneven'. Resurgence of vaccine-preventable diseases reflects eroding public health systems.

signals.title: ILO: 1 Billion Workers Need Reskilling — Only 21% of Global Workforce Engaged
signals.summary: ILO's 2026 Employment and Social Trends report: 1 billion workers need reskilling for AI-automated landscape. Net job gain of 78 million by 2030 (170M created, 92M eliminated). Only 21% employee engagement globally despite productivity tools. Only 54% used AI in past year — digital divide widening.
signals.implications: Skills gap is widest in developing economies. Low engagement despite AI tools suggests technology alone does not solve workforce challenges. Education systems need fundamental redesign.

signals.title: Commonwealth Fusion Systems: SPARC on Track for First Plasma 2027, ARC Plant Early 2030s
signals.summary: SPARC fusion reactor nearly complete, first plasma 2027. Commercial plant ARC planned for early 2030s near Richmond, VA — 400MW, enough for 300,000 homes. China's EAST reactor broke fusion stability limits. AI and Nvidia GPUs now accelerating fusion research.
signals.implications: Fusion energy timeline accelerating from 'always 30 years away' to concrete milestones. If SPARC succeeds, it validates the high-field superconducting magnet approach for commercial fusion.

signals.title: CRISPR Revolution 2026: Gene Editing Without Cutting DNA, Pediatric Trials Expanding
signals.summary: New CRISPR technique turns genes on without cutting DNA by removing chemical tags. Casgevy approved in 10+ countries. Phase III trials expanding to children aged 5-11. FDA issued 'plausible mechanism' guidance enabling platform therapy trials. Over 250 gene-editing clinical trials now active.
signals.implications: Non-cutting gene editing dramatically reduces safety concerns, potentially accelerating regulatory approval. Platform therapy framework could streamline rare disease treatments.

signals.title: DOE Quantum Research Centers Achieve Breakthrough Toward Scalable Quantum Computers
signals.summary: DOE national quantum research centers reached milestone toward building scalable quantum computers. SEEQC achieved full-stack quantum computing at 10mK with integrated digital control logic, cutting the 'wiring bottleneck'. Scientists may have found the 'holy grail' of quantum computing.
signals.implications: Solving the wiring bottleneck removes a key barrier to scaling beyond hundreds of qubits. Accelerates timeline for quantum advantage in optimization, drug discovery, and cryptography.

signals.title: US Homelessness Hits Record 771,480 — Working Homeless Phenomenon Expanding
signals.source: CNN / National Alliance to End Homelessness
signals.summary: US homelessness increased 18% to record 771,480 in latest count. Shortage of 7.1 million affordable homes for extremely low-income renters. Nearly half of US renters paying over 30% of income on housing. Working homeless phenomenon expanding — employed but unable to afford housing.
signals.implications: Housing affordability crisis becoming structural rather than cyclical. Risk of social instability as middle-class working people face housing insecurity.

signals.title: Malicious Python Package litellm Compromised — Supply Chain Attack on AI Infrastructure
signals.summary: Popular Python AI package litellm compromised by TeamPCP threat actor with credential harvester, Kubernetes lateral movement toolkit, and persistent backdoor in versions 1.82.7-1.82.8 published March 24. Previously compromised Trivy and KICS security tools.
signals.implications: AI software supply chain becoming prime attack vector. Organizations using AI toolchains face compound risk from dependencies. Need for AI-specific software composition analysis.

signals.title: FCC Proposes Rules to Address Offshore Call Centers — Onshoring Push
signals.summary: FCC considering Notice of Proposed Rulemaking to address problems with offshore call centers, including actions to encourage onshoring and improve customer service. Part of broader trend toward reshoring service sector jobs.
signals.implications: Signals regulatory push toward domestic service delivery. Could increase costs for telecom and customer service industries while boosting domestic employment.

signals.title: OECD: Digital Technology in Education Replicates Old Practices — Transformation Gap Persists
signals.summary: OECD Digital Education Outlook 2026 finds digital technology predominantly replicates existing teaching practices rather than enabling pedagogical transformation. GenAI tools with intentional pedagogical purpose show sustained learning improvements. Interoperability requirements emerging as policy priority.
signals.implications: Massive education technology investment yielding suboptimal returns. Countries that integrate AI with pedagogical redesign will gain competitive advantage in workforce readiness.

signals.title: Asia-Pacific Biodiversity Loss Threatens Economic Growth — 40% of Global Natural Capital Lost
signals.summary: IPBES reports 40% of global natural capital lost. Asia-Pacific wildlife populations dropped 60% since 1970. A quarter of endemic species at risk. 60% of grasslands degraded. 45% of wetlands disappeared. Water scarcity affecting agriculture, manufacturing, and data centers.
signals.implications: Nature-related financial risks becoming material for investors. Biodiversity loss creating systemic economic risks comparable to climate change.

signals.title: Executive Order 14396 'Preserving America's Game' Published
signals.summary: Executive Order 14396 titled 'Preserving America's Game' published in the Federal Register on March 25, 2026. Details of the order's scope and provisions were not fully available in the search results.
signals.implications: Cultural policy signal from the administration. Specific implications depend on the order's detailed provisions.

signals.title: Energy-Multiplying Solar Breakthrough Could Push Efficiency Beyond 100%
signals.summary: A new 'energy-multiplying' solar breakthrough could push efficiency beyond 100% theoretical single-junction limits by capturing and converting energy that conventional cells waste. This could transform how solar energy is captured and utilized.
signals.implications: If commercially viable, could dramatically reduce the land area and cost needed for solar generation. Potential to reshape renewable energy economics.

signals.title: Metformin Works in the Brain — New Pathway Discovery After Decades of Study
signals.summary: Researchers discovered metformin works not just in the body but in the brain, identifying previously unknown pathways after decades of study. This could expand the drug's therapeutic applications beyond diabetes.
signals.implications: Opens new therapeutic avenues for neurodegenerative diseases. Could accelerate drug repurposing for brain-related conditions at minimal development cost.

signals.title: IonQ-CCRM Strategic Quantum-Biotech Collaboration for Advanced Therapeutics
signals.summary: IonQ and CCRM announced collaboration focusing on bioprocess optimization, disease-modeling workflows, and quantum-enhanced simulation for advanced therapy design and manufacturing. Projects launching in Canada and Sweden.
signals.implications: Convergence of quantum computing and biotech could accelerate drug discovery and manufacturing processes. First concrete industry partnerships beyond proof-of-concept.

signals.title: Global Cooperation Barometer 2026 — WEF Warns of Declining International Cooperation
signals.summary: WEF Global Cooperation Barometer 2026 documents declining international cooperation. Rising polarization challenges democratic systems. 'Streets versus elites' narratives reflect deepening disillusionment with traditional governance.
signals.implications: Fragmentation of global cooperation impairs collective response to transnational challenges (climate, pandemics, arms control). Multilateral institutions under existential stress.

signals.title: NASA Artemis 2 Gets 'Go' for Moon Flyby — ISRO Gaganyaan-1 Also Imminent
signals.summary: NASA Artemis 2 teams gave 'go' to launch and fly around the moon, pending final work before rollout. ISRO aims to launch Gaganyaan-1, India's first uncrewed orbital test flight. China launching Qingzhou cargo spacecraft to Tiangong station.
signals.implications: Space exploration entering new multi-polar era with US, India, and China all pursuing major missions simultaneously. Commercial space continues to grow.

signals.title: D2D Satellite Spending Hits $8 Billion — Apple and Samsung Integrating NTN by Default
signals.summary: Direct-to-Device satellite spending expected to reach $8 billion in 2026. Apple and Samsung integrating Non-Terrestrial Network modems as default in 2026 product cycles. SpaceX launching multiple Starlink batches weekly.
signals.implications: Universal connectivity becoming reality. Disrupts terrestrial telecom business models. Enables connected services in previously unreachable areas.

signals.title: Deforestation Directly Causing Water Crisis — 122 Million at Risk in West Africa
signals.summary: Deforestation across Ghana, Niger, and Nigeria threatening 122 million people's water access. For every 1,000 hectares of forest cleared, 9.25 hectares of surface water disappear. Big biodiversity goals face funding shortfall reality.
signals.implications: Environmental degradation creating cascading humanitarian crises. Biodiversity financing gap undermines international conservation commitments.

signals.title: McKinsey: Geopolitics Reshaping Geometry of Global Trade — 2026 Update
signals.summary: McKinsey's 2026 update shows geopolitics fundamentally reshaping global trade patterns. AI-related trade emerged as single largest growth driver in 2025. Trade deficit migration from China to Vietnam and Taiwan. EU caught in 'double squeeze' from both US tariffs and Chinese imports.
signals.implications: Trade realignment creating winners and losers among nations. Companies must build resilient, multi-corridor supply chains. AI trade becoming strategic national priority.

signals.title: Deloitte: 2026 Global Economic Outlook — Accumulated Imbalances, Constrained Policy
signals.summary: Deloitte's global economic outlook warns of accumulated imbalances amid deepening geoeconomic fragmentation. Central banks face constrained policy choices. Rising debt burdens narrow path to stable growth. Financial volatility set to increase.
signals.implications: Limited fiscal and monetary policy space increases vulnerability to additional shocks. Economic fragmentation may become permanent structural feature.

signals.title: CATL Deploys Sodium-Ion Batteries Across Four Sectors at Scale
signals.summary: CATL widely applying sodium-ion batteries (Naxtra product line) in battery swapping, passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and energy storage in 2026. Combined with solid-state battery roadmap targeting 2027-2028 commercialization.
signals.implications: Battery technology diversification reduces dependence on lithium supply chains. CATL's scale production could set global pricing benchmarks.

signals.title: Medicaid, ACA, and SNAP Cuts Taking Effect — Healthcare Access Shrinking
signals.summary: 2025 legislation making deep cuts to Medicaid, ACA marketplaces, and SNAP programs taking effect in 2026. Policies making it harder for low-income people to sign up for ACA coverage. Disproportionate impact on minority communities — signs of 'Black recession' emerging.
signals.implications: Social safety net erosion during economic uncertainty increases vulnerability of most fragile populations. Healthcare access reduction could increase emergency costs and worsen outcomes.

signals.title: FATF Travel Rule for Virtual Assets Takes Effect March 2026
signals.summary: FATF Travel Rule requirements came into force March 2026, bringing greater transparency to virtual asset transactions. Combined with MiCA full implementation in EU and US GENIUS Act, creating most comprehensive global crypto regulatory framework ever.
signals.implications: End of crypto 'Wild West' era. Compliance costs will drive consolidation among smaller players. Increased transparency could boost institutional adoption.

signals.title: Hyundai AI+Robotics Roadmap — Modular Robots with LLM Integration for Logistics
signals.summary: Hyundai detailed AI+Robotics roadmap at CES 2026. New modular robot platform for logistics and personal assistance integrating LLMs and generative AI. Expanded Boston Dynamics partnership. Robotics era shifting from 'foundational' to 'deployment' phase.
signals.implications: LLM-powered robots entering real-world deployment in logistics, healthcare, and personal assistance. Major labor market implications for warehouse and delivery workers.

signals.title: Google Overtakes IBM as Global Leader in Generative AI Patent Filings
signals.summary: Google overtook IBM as global leader in generative AI patent filings. Over 12,400 generative AI patents filed globally in 2025, with US receiving 5,100+ applications. USPTO precedent in Ex parte Desjardins (Google/DeepMind) shifting AI patent eligibility landscape.
signals.implications: AI IP race intensifying. Patent landscape will determine competitive advantage in AI deployment. USPTO shift on AI patentability could unlock innovation or create patent thickets.

signals.title: OpenAI's Grand Challenge: Building Fully Automated AI Researcher Agent
signals.summary: OpenAI announced its new 'north star' goal: building an AI researcher — a fully automated agent-based system capable of tackling large, complex research problems independently. This represents a shift from language model development to autonomous scientific reasoning.
signals.implications: If successful, could accelerate scientific discovery exponentially. Raises profound questions about the role of human researchers and the governance of autonomous scientific agents.

signals.title: Climate Litigation Surge — New Cases Filed Globally in March 2026
signals.summary: Climate litigation continues to accelerate globally. New cases filed including a landmark New Zealand climate case. Courts increasingly being used to enforce climate commitments and hold governments and corporations accountable.
signals.implications: Legal climate risk becoming material for corporate strategy. Litigation outcomes could force policy action where legislation stalls.

signals.title: US Population Growth Slowing to One-Third of Previous Rate — Workforce Crisis Deepening
signals.summary: US projected to add only 23 million people over next 30 years — roughly one-third of 1995-2024 growth rate. Demographic shifts making human capacity itself a scarce resource. Automation filling gaps but productivity lagging due to 21% global employee engagement.
signals.implications: Demographic decline is structural and irreversible in the medium term. Immigration policy, automation investment, and workforce redesign become existential strategic priorities.

signals.title: Psilocybin Compounds Explored for Depression, PTSD, Addiction, and Obesity Treatment
signals.summary: Scientific interest in psilocybin mushroom compounds has exploded over the last decade, with research expanding into treatments for depression, PTSD, addiction, and now obesity. Regulatory pathways and clinical trials advancing in multiple jurisdictions.
signals.implications: Psychedelic medicine could disrupt the $30B+ antidepressant market. Regulatory acceptance growing but social stigma remains a barrier to mainstream adoption.

signals.title: Meta Signs Nuclear Power Deal — Tech Giants Turning to Nuclear for AI Data Centers
signals.summary: Meta signed deals with three nuclear companies as AI ambitions require stable, massive energy supply. Nuclear becoming favored energy source for tech companies. Data center energy consumption is a growing concern across the industry.
signals.implications: AI energy demands creating unexpected renaissance for nuclear power. Could accelerate new nuclear deployment but raises long-term waste and safety questions.

signals.title: AgTech Innovation: AI-Designed Feed Additives Cut Cattle Methane for Net-Zero Farming
signals.summary: AgTech summit showcased AI-designed feed additives reducing cattle methane emissions for net-zero farming. Gene-edited European crops advancing toward field testing. British Columbia deploying smart-farming greenhouses with AI monitoring. RAAPID initiative using satellite data for food system disruption assessment.
signals.implications: Agriculture technology converging AI, gene editing, and precision farming to address food security and climate simultaneously. Could transform global food production systems.

signals.title: America's DataHub Consortium and National Advanced Mobility Consortium — Federal R&D Collaboration
signals.summary: Federal Register notices for America's Datahub Consortium, National Advanced Mobility Consortium, Mercury Consortium, and others under the National Cooperative Research and Production Act. Signals continued federal support for collaborative R&D in data, mobility, and communications.
signals.implications: Consortium approach to R&D indicates government prioritizing public-private partnerships for strategic technology development.

signals.title: 6.5 Million Somalis Facing Crisis Hunger — Climate-Driven Food Emergency
signals.summary: About 6.5 million Somalis facing crisis-level hunger, with 1.8 million children under five in acute malnutrition. Caused by severe drought, failed harvests, and high food prices. Pakistan warns of accelerating glacier melt risks. Australia experienced five disasters in one wet season.
signals.implications: Climate change effects disproportionately hitting vulnerable populations. Cascading humanitarian crises straining international aid capacity and creating migration pressures.

signals.title: NIST Invites Feedback on AI Agent Security Standards via CAISI
signals.summary: NIST's Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) soliciting public feedback on managing security risks from AI agents. Shadow AI problem growing — 76% of organizations cite it as definite or probable issue, up 15 points year-over-year.
signals.implications: AI agent security standards could become baseline for enterprise AI deployment. Shadow AI risk growing faster than governance frameworks can address.
